title: where・when・whyで背景を説明

chapter.title: 名詞を後ろから特定する

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational; dense 9:16 portrait grammar page. Teach WHERE for situations, formal in which, WHEN for time, and WHY for reason from p.432–433 coverage.
Input references: PAGE_0001 design and mascot identity.
Top title: 「where・when・whyで背景を説明」
Central illustration: mascot as a time-space navigator at three portals: WHERE for place/situation, WHEN for a clock point, WHY for a reason trail. A small formal panel converts where to in which.
Mechanism: 「where＝場所・状況の穴」「in which＝場所を名詞＋前置詞で厳密に」「when＝時の穴」「the reason why＝理由の穴」.
Original examples: “We faced a situation where every choice was risky.” / 「どの選択も危険な状況」; “That was the year when I learned to swim.” / 「泳ぎを覚えた年」; “The reason why I left early was the storm.” / 「早く帰った理由」; “This is the room in which the records are stored.” / 「記録を保管する部屋・改まった形」.
Mini problem: 「ミニ問題：時を指定する」 “I remember the day (where / when) we found the puppy.” Answer 「when」. Reason 「欠けているのは“その日に”という時の情報。」
Bottom ribbon: 「場所・時・理由の穴を、正しいwh語で案内しよう」
Style: glossy adventure-library navigator chamber, blue/gold/white/red portals, clocks, map pins and reason trail, thick outlines, dense readable educational composition.
Constraints: exact 9:16; no page number, copied source text/examples/figures/layout, source identity, logo, citation, watermark, blank answer field, or photorealism. Exactly one mascot in navigator pose.
